status: Programme autorisé : quatorze illustrations, dont une image du port fournie et treize créations. Détails non attestés : interprétations artistiques. Images seules montrables uniquement à la découverte correspondante, jamais une galerie anticipée.
common: Create an original premium fantasy tabletop adventure book painting matching ONLY the traditional painterly treatment of the reference, not its characters, species or setting. Rich oil and gouache textures, carefully observed faces and materials, believable creature anatomy, subtle warm ochres and bronze balanced by maritime blues, sea greens and cool stone. An evocative D&D adventure on rocky Thayan islands, not horror pasted onto every room, not cartoon, anime, photograph or glossy 3D. Do not imitate a named living artist. Distinct faces for distinct people; do not reuse a referenced portrait's identity. Irregular dry-brushed edges fading into warm ivory parchment, no rectangular border. Important anatomy and faces within central 80 percent. No words, letters, inscriptions, captions, logo, watermark, map, speech bubble, modern object or invented faction emblem. No player characters, presumed player action, rescue already completed, combat outcome, secret route, invisible companion, revealed disguise or hidden evidence. Only visible details of the described scene. No corpse, torture, supernatural aura or active spell unless explicitly requested. These are setting illustrations, not mechanically exact plans. Nobody in the new portraits is a Red Wizard: no scarlet wizard robes, shaved tattooed mage heads or magic tattoos. Do not transplant the bell, cult, copper dragon, goblins or other subjects of the Cavernes book. Monastery interiors are rock hewn to imitate masonry, spare decoration, hooded hanging lanterns, working wool robes and wooden clogs, not gilded cathedrals.

images.label: Ala Harbor
images.source: The Alaor, illustration fournie d’Ala Harbor, chapitre Thay. Réutilisation privée, retrait du cadre inférieur seulement, pas un port généré.

images.label: Mirel Astafar
images.source: Original, Beginning the Adventure : wealthy well-dressed human woman, sending stone, grilled fish and wine ; traits fins proposés.
images.prompt: Mirel Astafar, a prosperous HUMAN woman merchant, seated in a quiet booth of a seaside tavern in Ala Harbor. Waist-up character portrait with a few still-life objects. She is thoughtfully worried and attentive rather than smiling for a formal portrait. Tasteful layered deep teal wool and cream linen, restrained merchant jewelry, no scarlet robe or armor. Choose an individual adult face with olive-brown complexion, dark wavy hair simply pinned back, intelligent brown eyes; these are artistic choices, not an official portrait. One natural hand rests on the tabletop and the other holds a small smooth polished sending stone without any glow. A plate of untouched grilled fish and a modest cup of wine sit beside her. Behind, a shaded stone arch and a distant blur of masts and sea give a harbor atmosphere, NOT mountains or a farming village. No sailor in danger, written contract, coin chest, secret symbol, tattoo, other portrait or scene from the quest. Anatomically believable hands, all fingers well separated, rich skin and cloth texture, understated human warmth.

images.label: Kranine Orso
images.source: Original : female tiefling captain, friendly, offers spyglass. Traits autres que l’espèce et le rôle proposés.
images.prompt: Kranine Orso, a practical friendly TIEFLING WOMAN sailing-ship captain, standing by a wooden ship rail. A confident weathered adult face distinct from Mirel's, dusky muted mauve skin, two elegant backward-curving dark horns, dark hair tied back and a glimpse of her single natural tail. An expression of alert competence and approachable good humor, not a demonic snarl. Dark indigo broadcloth captain's coat over pale linen, leather belt and a subdued sea-green scarf, no modern naval uniform, pirate skull, scarlet mage robe, crown, ceremonial armor or invented rank badge. She holds a closed brass spyglass in one hand while the other rests naturally on the rail. Rigging, a reefed pale sail and calm harbor water softly suggested behind. No dragon, payment chest, sinking ship, lifeboat full of PCs, magic, extra arms or victory. Premium book portrait with tactile horn, cloth and wood, sea light and parchment-faded edges.

images.label: Skalanthas surgit de la mer
images.source: Original, Skalanthas Strikes : young bronze dragon the size of a grizzly bear, emerging from water beside an intact ship ; small horns and frills mentioned in dragon history.
images.prompt: A YOUNG BRONZE DRAGON named Skalanthas erupts from a blue-green sea beside an intact wooden sailing ship and opens his wings to rise. His body is roughly grizzly-bear sized, a large young dragon, NOT a titanic adult towering over cliffs and NOT a baby wyrmling. Metallic antique-bronze scales with subtle green patina in the creases, a robust coastal dragon head with SHORT small backward horns and characteristic short jaw and head frills, strong neck, four separate legs, two membranous wings and a long tail. No huge red-dragon horn crown, copper-orange coloration, beak, mammal fur, armor, saddle, rider or extra limbs. Water sheets off scales in crisp painterly spray. On one side, a small part of the intact ship's bow and rigging establishes scale; do not show anyone being struck, falling, drowning or rescued. White sea cliffs with wisps of coastal fog in the distance, clear daylight over the sea, a tense magnificent arrival rather than a completed attack. No lightning or fire breath, ruin, sunken wreck, hoard, sea monster or other dragon. Wide cinematic composition with the dragon clearly readable and all major anatomy inside the painted edges.

images.label: Le refuge dans la falaise
images.source: Original M1–M3 : monastery cut into east wall of sea cave, narrow stained glass, small wooden pier and fishing rowboat, rocky ledges ; vue partielle non cartographique.
images.prompt: An inviting yet isolated rock-hewn monastery partly hidden inside a sea cave beneath white coastal cliffs. View from near the water looking INTO the cave, not a top-down plan. On the viewer's right, the monastery's modest carved-stone exterior is integrated into the natural cliff, with a few narrow stained-glass windows looking over the water. A small weathered wooden pier on stone posts and one simple fishing rowboat sit nearby. A worn stone walkway hugs the cliff toward an oak entrance, with a tiny goat visible on the upper exposed path. Across the water on the left, bare natural ledges recede into shadow. Light sea mist at the cave mouth, restrained clear water reflections and warm stone, no enormous freestanding cathedral or fortress built on top of the island. No dragon, crowds, secret submerged tunnel, boulder plug, treasure, traps, pirate ship, bound survivors, readable inscription or lit magic. An atmospheric landscape, not a floor plan or promise of exact room geometry.

images.label: Ashlyn Maranta
images.source: Original M11a : female elf with pale blue skin, brave, saddened by lost shipmates. Cheveux, vêtements et visage proposés.
images.prompt: Ashlyn Maranta, a brave FEMALE ELF sailor with unmistakably PALE BLUE SKIN and long elven ears. An individual lean adult face, quiet resolve and contained tiredness, not a corpse or a weeping caricature. Dark blue-grey hair in a loose practical braid, calm sea-grey eyes, faint weathering from salt and wind. Simple repaired maritime wool shirt and worn grey-brown vest, no ornate noble dress, wizard robe, armor, scarlet cloth, weapon raised or magical aura. A waist-up portrait in the spare guest room of a peaceful cliffside monastery, plain stone and a soft blur of an ordinary wooden bed behind. She has had several days of shelter and is not drenched, tied up or bleeding. Hands relaxed and natural, no gills or supernatural effects revealing a power. No dead captain, shipwreck flashback, rescue scene, other survivor, secret passage or identifiable loot. Keep her blue skin luminous but natural under soft sea light, not bright cyan makeup.

images.label: Devi Talzar
images.source: Original M11b : middle-aged human woman with kind face, priest of stars and wanderers, sending stone ; visage fin proposé, divinité non fixée.
images.prompt: Devi Talzar, a middle-aged HUMAN WOMAN priest with a genuinely kind, patient face and quiet courage. A face clearly distinct from Mirel and Ashlyn, warm deep-brown skin, expressive dark eyes, dark hair threaded with grey, practical loose braid or bun. Simple travel-worn blue-grey robes with a small restrained woven star pattern, no specific named deity's heraldry, elaborate crown, pointed ears, Red Wizard tattoos or scarlet robe. She holds an ordinary smooth sending stone gently in one palm, not casting a visible spell. Calm waist-up pose in a sheltered bare stone guest cell, a folded blanket and dim sea light suggested behind. Neither helpless captive nor triumphant sorceress. No glowing holy symbol, wings, halo, magical portal, danger, corpse, other character, rescue in progress or revealed plot. Her bearing should feel trustworthy, deliberate and capable without inventing a rank or a combat role. Soft richly painted face and cloth with natural faded parchment edges.

images.label: Treef Lameer
images.source: Original M11c : fifteen-year-old human boy from wealthy family, nephew of captain ; physical fine details proposed.
images.prompt: Treef Lameer, a FIFTEEN-YEAR-OLD HUMAN BOY, a believable adolescent, not a grown adult warrior or small child. Slim build, soft youthful facial structure, absolutely no beard or moustache, tousled chestnut hair and keen grey-brown eyes. His expression is guarded, frustrated and stubborn but not malicious; quiet portrait rather than a tantrum. A once-fine but salt-worn olive and cream traveling doublet marks a privileged upbringing without a crown, invented noble crest or sumptuous modern uniform. Waist-up near a plain stone guest-room wall and unadorned wooden bed, hands resting calmly on a knee or folded loosely, no weapon drawn. No murdered aunt, visible revenge target, Ronnom, poison, shackles, extra character or fight. Fully clothed age-appropriate tabletop character portrait, no romance or glamor posing, subtle maritime light and controlled painterly skin texture. Distinct face, no reuse of Mirel's identity.

images.label: Anish
images.source: Original M15–M17 : older aasimar man, gentle disposition, wool robe and wooden clogs, snake-headed cane ; autres traits proposés.
images.prompt: Hierarch Anish, an ELDERLY MALE AASIMAR monk, as a gentle psychologically convincing three-quarter character portrait, framed from head to below knees if possible. Weathered kindly face, fine wrinkles, silver hair and short silver beard, subtle warm amber-grey eyes but NO glowing eyes, wings or halo. A humanlike appearance with quiet dignity, not a demonic being or a battle cleric. Plain undyed grey-brown wool robe tied with a simple cord; wooden clogs if the feet enter the frame. He leans naturally on a carved wooden cane with a modest SNAKE-SHAPED HEAD. The cane is a mundane-looking carved object here, not a living snake, glowing staff or revelation of its powers. Behind, a spare rock-hewn meditation hall and a partial life-size stone goat statue in a corner, no golden cathedral or secret imagery. He is listening and welcoming, no visitor, prisoner, key, inked clue, scarlet robe or magical tattoo. Give him an individual face unlike the other portraits and soft painterly lantern light.

images.label: L’atelier des tisserands
images.source: Original M19 : wooden loom, wool, tools, monks weave robes. Vignette d’activité quotidienne, non disposition initiale de l’assemblée.
images.prompt: A quiet daily-life vignette in the cliffside monastery's weaving workshop. A sturdy wooden hand loom occupies the foreground, baskets of unspun local sheep wool, wooden spindles and shuttles, folded coarse grey and sea-green cloth, simple shears and unmarked clay dye jars. Two unarmed monks in plain wool working robes, one human and one dwarf, calmly attend to the weaving and yarn; they are ordinary unnamed craftspeople, not adventuring combat monks. Natural believable weaving posture and tools, anatomically correct hands, no branded machinery. The room is carved from solid rock to resemble simple blocks, floor carved like stone slabs, restrained light from a hooded hanging lantern. A warm lived-in place that explains how the monastery sustains itself. No written clue, hidden door, magical cloth, secret pattern, poison, strange device, pig statue or fantasy subplot. This is an everyday view, not a claim that these two are absent from the initial assembly in another room. Wide painterly composition with tactile wool and timber, soft parchment-faded margins.

images.label: La crypte des supérieurs
images.source: Original M18 : quarter-circle room, clay urns and painted portraits ; aucune activation ou solution du trésor représentée.
images.prompt: A contemplative partial view of the old hierarchs' crypt in a peaceful rock-hewn monastery. A curved stone wall suggests a quarter-circle room, simple lidded clay funerary urns arranged along its base or low ledge, with small worn hand-painted portraits of different meditating monks above their corresponding urns. Show only part of the room, the row continuing beyond the frame, so it is not an inaccurate counted diagram of all thirty urns. Any markings on lids are tiny indistinct paint texture, NO readable writing or magical glyph. Quiet natural earthy clay, slate rock, faded portraits and restrained hanging lantern light. Respectful and serene, not an evil necromantic tomb. Absolutely no person touching an urn, spectral monk, glow, magical protection visual, lightning, trap, labyrinth, chalk snake figure, pig statue, hidden door, open urn, exposed remains or treasure. The image must not reveal what the urns do. A wide richly textured still interior, painterly edges fading naturally into warm ivory.

images.label: Les deux joueurs de cartes
images.source: Original M25 : two slender human men who resemble brothers, unarmed/unarmored, cards at small table. True nature deliberately excluded.
images.prompt: Two slender HUMAN MEN who look like adult brothers play a quiet card game at a small plain wooden table in a modest stone room. Both have ordinary natural human faces with familial resemblance but distinct expressions, dark hair, simple brown-grey shirts and trousers, no armor or visible weapons. Calm, reserved, neither ostentatiously villainous nor unnaturally vacant. Each sits on one chair; one holds a modest fan of plain cards and the other places a card on the tabletop, anatomically correct natural hands. The cards may show tiny unidentifiable fantasy pictures but no readable text or letters. The edge of two neatly made wooden beds and a plain chest of drawers suggest the room. A hooded lantern illuminates worn wood and stone. No monstrous features, shapeshifting, reflected true faces, strange shadows, disguise split-screen, extra eyes, mind-reading effect, invisible woman, body double, poison, hidden passage or secret clue. Exactly two visible people, no player characters. A horizontal ordinary encounter scene that can be shown on first meeting without revealing any hidden identity.

images.label: Ronnom Daamos
images.source: Original M26 : adult human male, speaks as fugitive noble; appearance not fixed. No visible Veen or evidence.
images.prompt: Ronnom Daamos, an adult HUMAN MAN presenting himself as a displaced gentleman, in a waist-up conversation portrait. A lean well-kept man of roughly middle adulthood, individual angular face, neatly cut dark hair, restrained short stubble, observant eyes and an apparently reasonable but guarded expression. Well-made yet travel-worn charcoal and muted olive clothing over plain linen, no wizard robes, scarlet mage uniform, facial tattoos, assassin hood, sinister skull ornament, mask or elaborate invented family crest. One relaxed visible hand gestures as if explaining his situation, the other rests at his side. A spare stone room and shadowed ordinary corridor softly suggested behind; no top-down route information or hidden door outlined. He must not be depicted killing, poisoning, fleeing, captured, confessing or riding a dragon. NO vial, poison bottle, murder trophy, visible weapon, money bribe, invisible companion, oni, red-haired woman or magical effect. An ambiguous human interlocutor, not a visual confession of his hidden crimes. Richly painted skin and dark fabric with soft parchment edges, face distinct from other characters.

images.label: L’antre de Skalanthas
images.source: Original M38 : young bronze dragon on dry rock shelf, water and natural pillar. Same dragon as emergence image; hoard in M39 omitted.
images.prompt: The SAME individual young bronze dragon Skalanthas as in the reference, now resting alertly on a broad dry rocky shelf in a damp sea cave. Keep his recognizable antique-bronze and subtle green-patina scales, short backward horns and head/jaw frills, muzzle shape and proportions. Four legs, two folded membranous wings, a long tail; body roughly grizzly-bear sized, NOT an enormous adult or a copper wyrmling. His head is turned toward an unseen visitor, expression watchful and intelligent, not attacking, grateful, wounded or defeated. A SINGLE major natural stone pillar rises near the shelf and dark water fills the foreground, simple rough vault above. Restrained painterly ambient reflection makes the dragon visible without inventing torches or a magical light source in a dark cave. No saddle or rider, Ronnom, player characters, handshake, obvious negotiated outcome, hidden tunnel, glowing magic, lightning, treasure pile, necklace, chest or sunken treasure boat. The image depicts only the visible lair, not the neighboring hoard room or a complete navigational map. An immersive wide composition, rich water and bronze textures, soft faded parchment edges.
